name: O. F. Davis
role: Attorney for the contestant in an 1884 land-office contest
bio: O. F. Davis signed as attorney for the contestant on a notice of contest from the Bismarck land office. The notice, in John Weber's case against John Peehn over the alleged abandonment of a homestead in Billings County, ran in the Cow Boy from July to September 1884.

moments.label: Signed land-office contest notice as contestant's attorney
Contest notice ran for the last time
